messages:
sara_sales: Hey team — running a POC demo with a UK gov agency and we hit repeated errors. They call model 'redwood-9b-v2' pinned in eu-west-2 but we see intermittent 429s and some responses say "model not available in region". Demo is in 30m, can we swarm?
leo_se: Can you paste the exact curl you used and the raw error?
sara_sales: Curl below. Response pasted after.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-9b-v2","input":"Summarize...","region":"eu-west-2"}'
```
Response snippets: `{"error":"model not available in region","code":404}` and also `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":3}` in other runs.
maya_infra: Thanks. Quick check — are they using a tenant pin in their request or relying on routing? If model is pinned to a hosted pool that isn't replicated to eu-west-2 we'll see that 404.
anil_sre: Also could be they hit shared-host rate limits during the demo spike — 429s + our fallback policy sometimes returns a structured 404 when a pin is incompatible. Need tenant id + request-id from the failing call (x-request-id).
sara_sales: Tenant is `gov-uk-tenant-71`. I grabbed one x-request-id: `req_0a1b2c3d`.
leo_se: Pulling logs now. Give me 60s.
deploy-bot: build/deploy completed: service/inference-router @ prod-2026-03-19T12:34Z :rocket:
leo_se: Logs show router attempted `/model/redwood-9b-v2` on eu-west-2 but returned 404 from model-catalog: "no replica in region". Also saw short burst of 429s 12:34:10-12:34:18 UTC.
maya_infra: Short-term workaround: set the request to fall back to `redwood-9b-compat-eu` (compatible variant) or route to our Dedicated trial region if they accept. Example patch: `"model":"redwood-9b-compat-eu"`.
emma_security: Two security asks from the customer: 1) KMS key residency confirmation (keys must stay in UK) and 2) whether we can provide an IP/CIDR allowlist for the dedicated pool. Can ops confirm?
oliver_acc: Pricing question: if they require a pinned model in eu-west-2 we recommend Dedicated. Ballpark commit to guarantee pool + pinning? Need a quick estimate to share in the RFP.
anil_sre: Ops/infra — for KMS: we have a UK KMS cluster for Private/Dedicated. For hosted, we can offer BYOK with keys in our UK KMS under enterprise contract. IP allowlist is configurable on Dedicated.
maya_infra: For the immediate demo, I've enabled soft-fallback policy on their tenant to prefer eu variants and to fallback to `-compat` models. That should remove 404s; 429s remain if they exceed shared quotas.
sara_sales: Thanks. I pushed the change and re-ran with same curl — no 404s now, got stable 200s but still a single 429 when we hit concurrency of ~15. Demo passed 2 of 3 scenarios. Customer asked: what stops this in prod?
leo_se: Prod-grade guarantee is Dedicated capacity + reserved slots. We can also run an autoscale config and pre-warm their steady-state. I'll follow up with an SLO note.
oliver_acc: On pricing — preliminary: Dedicated minimum for guaranteed pin in region typically starts at ~250k USD/yr commit for this model tier; I'll put together a tailored quote and capacity plan.
emma_security: I'll prep a short KMS/IP/writeup for them and attach to the security questionnaire. sara, can you forward the questionnaire items?
sara_sales: Forwarding now. Also creating internal ticket PROD-12345 to track pin + quota requests + security docs.
leo_se: Action items: 1) ops confirm KMS/IP (emma/anil) 2) oliver to share pricing quote 3) infra to propose Dedicated trial (maya) 4) sales to deliver SOW + questionnaire answers (sara).
maya_infra: I'm scheduling a small capacity bump for their tenant for the next demo window. Will monitor logs.
anil_sre: I'll set a temp quota increase to avoid demo-time 429s (expires in 72h) and document changes in PROD-12345.
sara_sales: Perfect — will update customer and confirm next demo time. :thumbsup:
leo_se: Marking thread resolved for now — ping me if the 429s reappear after the bump. :eyes:
